seed: tower keep policies < $EXT/shots/seed/morning-triage.md && tower keep policies < $EXT/shots/seed/dependency-updates.md && tower keep policies < $EXT/shots/seed/release-notes.md
id=$(ls $TOWER_SANDBOX/collections/lab/policies | grep release-notes) && tower policies approve $id && echo 'Link each entry to its pull request.' >> $TOWER_SANDBOX/collections/lab/policies/$id

id=$(ls $TOWER_SANDBOX/collections/lab/policies | grep morning-triage) && slot=$(node -e 'const d = new Date(); d.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0); console.log(+d)') && tower x policies pass "{\"project\": \"lab\", \"policy\": \"$id\", \"slot\": $slot, \"outcome\": \"offered\"}"
